description: Defines the interface class 'resource_grid_writer' for writing resource elements in a resource grid, including methods for placing symbols with various subcarrier and symbol arrangements.

classes.name: resource_grid_writer
classes.description: Interface for writing resource elements into a resource grid, with methods for placing symbols and accessing grid views.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Places resource elements into the grid at a specified port and symbol, using a bitset mask to select subcarriers.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Places resource elements into the grid at a specified port and symbol, using a bitset mask to select subcarriers, with different data types.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Places a sequence of resource elements starting at a specific subcarrier index.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Places resource elements with a specified stride between them.

methods.name: get_view
methods.description: Returns a modifiable view of a specific OFDM symbol for a given port.
